name: write_range
description: Write a 2-D array of values starting at the top-left cell of `range` (rows of cells). Numbers, booleans, null (clears) and strings are accepted; strings starting with = are formulas ("=SUM(B2:B4)"), other strings are parsed like typed input ("12%", "1/2/2024", "$5"). One undo step. Example: {"range":"A1","values":[["Item","Cost"],["Rent",1200]]}.

range.description: Top-left cell or range, e.g. "A1" or "Sheet2!B3"
